description: What sales tax applies to each of these orders? Combined and per-jurisdiction rates for up to 100 US addresses, ZIP+4s or ZIPs in one call, 24 Streamlined Sales Tax states, computed by Distill from each state’s SST rate and boundary files. The same answer as tax.sales_rate for each location, in order. A location that fails (outside the SST states, a bad date) carries its own error; the call is still one price. Updated quarterly. Price: $0.1 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: The lowest per-location confidence in the batch; each is agreement × freshness. Agreement: for a 5-digit ZIP answer, the share of that ZIP’s ZIP+4 records with the same combined rate; for a ZIP+4 answer, the share of address records inside it with the same rate; 1 for an address match or when the state publishes nothing finer. Freshness: 1 until the next SST posting deadline (the 1st of Mar, Jun, Sep or Dec) after the files were last checked, then halving every 30 days. Not tax advice. Rates as published by the state in its Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the stated effective period; verify with the state. See /terms.

address.description: Optional street address line with house number, e.g. "1010 E Alder St" or "PO Box 12"; matched against the state address records when it publishes them.

date.description: The sale date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC). From the first day of the previous quarter onward.

zip.description: A 5-digit ZIP code or a ZIP+4 (98101-3143 or 981013143).
